item.rudues.fire_fiend.tooltip1: A tiny fiend of purple flame.
item.rudues.fire_fiend.tooltip2: Use it to gain permanent Strength V & Resistance III
item.rudues.fire_fiend.tooltip3: and the power of the Skill Wheel (hold R). Immune to fire.
ability.rudues.rage_blast.desc: Hurl a purple fireball that explodes, destroys blocks and sets things ablaze.
ability.rudues.obliterator.desc: A close-range fire punch: huge damage, huge knockback, sets targets on fire.
ability.rudues.fiend_summon.desc: Summon flying purple flame fiends that dive at enemies and explode.
ability.rudues.violent_gale.desc: Send a piercing wind slash flying forward.
ability.rudues.stand_ground.desc: Massive Resistance (full immunity) plus extra hearts for 8 seconds.
ability.rudues.concentrated_beam.desc: Inhale, then breathe a purple flame & lightning beam from your maw for 3 seconds.
ability.rudues.obliterator_maximum.desc: A devastating punch of purple flames and purple lightning.
ability.rudues.hellfire.desc: Roar for 3 seconds as fountains of purple fire erupt across a huge area, then detonate in a colossal explosion.
ability.rudues.slash_combo.desc: Rake your claws through enemies in a multi-hit combo.
message.rudues.power_gained: The Fire Fiend's power surges through you!
message.rudues.already_powered: You already carry the Fire Fiend's power.
message.rudues.hero_awakened: The gauge is full... the Hero of Hell awakens!
message.rudues.hero_ended: The Hero of Hell form fades.
gui.rudues.wheel_hint: Point at a move and release the key (or click) to select it
ability.rudues.meteor_impact.desc: Rush forward; if you catch an enemy you grab them, leap high and slam them into the ground.
ability.rudues.tree_of_sin.desc: Summon an axe of living roots, rush an enemy, grab them and carve them with a savage combo.
